5|Backshift.rule_explanation_en: In Reported Speech, when the reporting verb is in the past, the tense in the reported clause usually moves one step back: Present Simple → Past Simple, Present Continuous → Past Continuous.
5|Backshift.rule_explanation_ru: В косвенной речи, если глагол, вводящий речь, стоит в прошедшем времени, время во второй части обычно сдвигается на шаг назад: Present Simple → Past Simple, Present Continuous → Past Continuous.

5|Example From the Dialogue.rule_explanation_ru: am having → was having (Present Continuous → Past Continuous): пример из диалога — «I am having an allergic reaction» → She said that she was having an allergic reaction (она сказала, что у неё аллергическая реакция).

5|Reporting Verb: Said.rule_explanation_en: Structure: said is usually followed by that + clause: She said that she had a nut allergy.
5|Reporting Verb: Said.rule_explanation_uz: Structure: said dan keyin ko'pincha that + clause keladi: She said that she had a nut allergy.
5|Reporting Verb: Said.rule_explanation_ru: Структура: после said обычно следует that + придаточное: She said that she had a nut allergy.

5|Reporting Verb: Told.rule_explanation_en: Told always needs an object — the person who was told: She told me that I should sit down and try to stay calm.
5|Reporting Verb: Told.rule_explanation_uz: Told har doim to'ldiruvchi — kimga aytilganini talab qiladi: She told me that I should sit down and try to stay calm.
5|Reporting Verb: Told.rule_explanation_ru: Told всегда требует дополнения — кому было сказано: She told me that I should sit down and try to stay calm.

5|Said vs Told.rule_explanation_en: say → the listener does not have to be named. tell → the listener is named (tell + someone + that…).
5|Said vs Told.rule_explanation_ru: say → указывать слушателя не обязательно. tell → слушатель указывается (tell + someone + that…).

5|Tell + Object.rule_explanation_en: Structure: tell + object + that + clause: The paramedic told me that I was having an allergic reaction.
5|Tell + Object.rule_explanation_uz: Structure: tell + to'ldiruvchi + that + clause: The paramedic told me that I was having an allergic reaction.
5|Tell + Object.rule_explanation_ru: Структура: tell + дополнение + that + придаточное: The paramedic told me that I was having an allergic reaction.

5|Reporting Verbs + Medical History.rule_explanation_en: This shows that the patient is passing on earlier medical advice: My doctor told me that I should always carry an adrenaline pen.
5|Reporting Verbs + Medical History.rule_explanation_ru: Это показывает, что пациент передаёт полученный ранее медицинский совет: My doctor told me that I should always carry an adrenaline pen.

5|Reporting Verbs — Important Medical Ve.rule_explanation_en: Reporting verbs used in emergency medicine: said, told, explained, reported, mentioned, confirmed, advised, warned — e.g. The nurse reported that her blood pressure was low.
5|Reporting Verbs — Important Medical Ve.rule_explanation_uz: Shoshilinch tibbiyotda ishlatiladigan reporting fe'llar: said, told, explained, reported, mentioned, confirmed, advised, warned — masalan, The nurse reported that her blood pressure was low.
5|Reporting Verbs — Important Medical Ve.rule_explanation_ru: Глаголы косвенной речи в неотложной медицине: said, told, explained, reported, mentioned, confirmed, advised, warned — например, The nurse reported that her blood pressure was low.

5|Tenses in the Dialogue.rule_explanation_en: This dialogue contains several important tenses: Past Simple for the sudden event (I suddenly became very unwell), Past Continuous for the background action (I was having an allergic reaction), and Past Perfect Continuous for what had been going on before (I had been eating for about half an hour).
5|Tenses in the Dialogue.rule_explanation_ru: В этом диалоге несколько важных времён: Past Simple для внезапного события (I suddenly became very unwell), Past Continuous для фонового действия (I was having an allergic reaction) и Past Perfect Continuous для того, что происходило до этого (I had been eating for about half an hour).

7|Important Difference: -ing vs V3.rule_explanation_en: Structure: V-ing | V3. The -ing participle is active — the noun performs the action (the nurse monitoring the patient); the V3 participle is passive — the action is done to the noun (the infected wound).
7|Important Difference: -ing vs V3.rule_explanation_uz: Structure: V-ing | V3. -ing sifatdoshi faol — ot harakatni o'zi bajaradi (the nurse monitoring the patient); V3 sifatdoshi majhul — harakat otga nisbatan bajarilgan (the infected wound).
7|Important Difference: -ing vs V3.rule_explanation_ru: Структура: V-ing | V3. Причастие на -ing — активное, существительное само выполняет действие (the nurse monitoring the patient); причастие V3 — пассивное, действие совершено над существительным (the infected wound).

9|Where.rule_explanation_en: Where is used to refer to a place: the ward where the patient collapsed.
9|Where.rule_explanation_ru: Where используется для указания места: the ward where the patient collapsed.

9|Clinical Application.rule_explanation_en: Relative clauses let the clinician identify exactly which patient, symptom or medication is meant: The patient who collapsed needs an ECG. The medication that he takes may affect his blood pressure.
9|Clinical Application.rule_explanation_uz: Nisbiy ergash gaplar shifokorga aynan qaysi bemor, simptom yoki dori nazarda tutilayotganini aniqlashga yordam beradi: The patient who collapsed needs an ECG. The medication that he takes may affect his blood pressure.
9|Clinical Application.rule_explanation_ru: Придаточные определительные позволяют врачу точно указать, какой пациент, симптом или препарат имеется в виду: The patient who collapsed needs an ECG. The medication that he takes may affect his blood pressure.

10|\"if You Had Known...\" — Past Conseq.rule_explanation_en: had known → Past Perfect; might have avoided → a possible result in the past. If he had known the tablets were dangerous, he might not have taken them.
10|\"if You Had Known...\" — Past Conseq.rule_explanation_ru: had known → Past Perfect; might have avoided → возможный результат в прошлом. If he had known the tablets were dangerous, he might not have taken them.

10|\"if He Had Known...\" vs \"if He Had.rule_explanation_en: Third Conditional (past condition → past result): If he had known…, he might not have taken them. Mixed Conditional (past condition → present result): If he had taken less, he might not be this drowsy now.
10|\"if He Had Known...\" vs \"if He Had.rule_explanation_uz: Third Conditional (o'tmishdagi shart → o'tmishdagi natija): If he had known…, he might not have taken them. Mixed Conditional (o'tmishdagi shart → hozirgi natija): If he had taken less, he might not be this drowsy now.
10|\"if He Had Known...\" vs \"if He Had.rule_explanation_ru: Third Conditional (условие в прошлом → результат в прошлом): If he had known…, he might not have taken them. Mixed Conditional (условие в прошлом → результат в настоящем): If he had taken less, he might not be this drowsy now.

10|Important Clinical Expressions.rule_explanation_en: Key expressions for an overdose case: we need to treat this as a potentially serious overdose; we cannot predict the outcome yet; our priority is to prevent further complications; please do not give him anything to eat or drink until we have assessed his swallowing.
10|Important Clinical Expressions.rule_explanation_uz: Dozani oshirib yuborish holati uchun asosiy iboralar: we need to treat this as a potentially serious overdose; we cannot predict the outcome yet; our priority is to prevent further complications; please do not give him anything to eat or drink until we have assessed his swallowing.
10|Important Clinical Expressions.rule_explanation_ru: Ключевые выражения для случая передозировки: we need to treat this as a potentially serious overdose; we cannot predict the outcome yet; our priority is to prevent further complications; please do not give him anything to eat or drink until we have assessed his swallowing.

10|Quick Comparison.rule_explanation_en: First Conditional — real future: If he becomes unconscious, we will assess his airway. Second Conditional — hypothetical present: If we knew the dose, we could assess the risk. Third Conditional — past: If he had taken less, he might not have become so drowsy. Mixed — past → now: If he had taken less, he might not be this drowsy now.
10|Quick Comparison.rule_explanation_uz: First Conditional — real kelajak: If he becomes unconscious, we will assess his airway. Second Conditional — faraziy hozirgi: If we knew the dose, we could assess the risk. Third Conditional — o'tmish: If he had taken less, he might not have become so drowsy. Mixed — o'tmish → hozir: If he had taken less, he might not be this drowsy now.
10|Quick Comparison.rule_explanation_ru: First Conditional — реальное будущее: If he becomes unconscious, we will assess his airway. Second Conditional — гипотетическое настоящее: If we knew the dose, we could assess the risk. Third Conditional — прошлое: If he had taken less, he might not have become so drowsy. Mixed — прошлое → настоящее: If he had taken less, he might not be this drowsy now.

10|Common Errors.rule_explanation_en: Do not use would in the if-clause: ❌ If he would have taken less medication… ✅ If he had taken less medication… ❌ If we would know the exact dose… ✅ If we knew the exact dose…
10|Common Errors.rule_explanation_uz: If qismida would ishlatilmaydi: ❌ If he would have taken less medication… ✅ If he had taken less medication… ❌ If we would know the exact dose… ✅ If we knew the exact dose…
10|Common Errors.rule_explanation_ru: Не используйте would в части с if: ❌ If he would have taken less medication… ✅ If he had taken less medication… ❌ If we would know the exact dose… ✅ If we knew the exact dose…
